command: Run the shipping Setup.exe through the Windows UI and upgrade the existing E:/Win-Box installation
mechanism: Visible real-machine upgrade of the shipping 1.27.1 installer. The old Win-Box process was running from E:/Win-Box. The installer initially prefilled the preceding isolated-test path because that path remained in InstallLocation; the target was manually changed to E:/Win-Box. The recommended stop-and-overwrite mode was selected. Setup closed the running app, completed installation, and the Run Win-Box checkbox was unchecked on the finish page. Win-Box.exe was then started manually from E:/Win-Box.

userDataSample.scope: regular user data files excluding cache, logs, and browser data; file contents were not printed or exported
userDataSample.interpretation: No byte-for-byte preservation conclusion: the baseline was collected while the old app was running; normal shutdown and first launch can persist state. Current source-group/site selection and viewing history were visible after upgrade. The prior favorites count was not recorded, so the empty favorites view does not establish data loss.

observations.userDataDirectoryPolicy: Existing E:/Win-Box/data was not removed by the selected in-place overwrite. App data was not inspected as plaintext.

limitations: Only the recommended same-path overwrite mode was exercised against the real installation.
The real uninstall-first path, Cancel/Back behavior, rollback after failed uninstall, and elevation were not exercised.
No pre-upgrade favorites count was captured; favorites retention cannot be compared.
The sampled non-cache profile digest changed, but file count and bytes matched and the baseline was taken while the app was running. The change cannot be attributed to installer data loss.
No release was published or remote branch pushed.
